puzzle.title: The Seal Beyond the Cave
puzzle.intro: Imagine a trusted soul in a city of idols, known for honesty long before revelation came. Retreat to a lonely cave, then a night journey of escape that would reshape history. Can you name this servant of Allah?
clues: I was known among my people as the trustworthy one before revelation came to me.
I retreated to a cave for worship when the first words of revelation descended upon me.
I faced boycott, mockery and grief in my city yet continued to call to one God.
I was taken by night from the sacred mosque to the farthest mosque and beyond.
I left my home by night with my companion, sheltering in a cave while pursuers searched.
I entered a new city where Allah established for me a community and completed my mission as a mercy to the worlds.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Prophet Isa
Prophet Muhammad
Prophet Nuh
Prophet Ibrahim
Prophet Musa

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Hijrah to Madinah and establishment of the community
Being swallowed by the great fish
Parting the sea to escape Pharaoh
Building the Ark to survive the Flood
Being thrown into the fire for breaking idols
trial.answer: Hijrah to Madinah and establishment of the community

location.label: Key Element
options: The blazing fire prepared by the idolaters
The Ark built under divine instruction
Cave of Thawr on the journey of migration
Mount Sinai where the Torah was received
Belly of the whale in the depths of the sea
location.answer: Cave of Thawr on the journey of migration

outcome.label: Outcome
options: The Flood drowned the disbelievers and the believers were saved
The fire became cool and peaceful by Allah's command
The whale released its captive after repentance and glorification
The sea drowned Pharaoh and his army
A secure community was founded and Islam spread as a mercy to the worlds
outcome.answer: A secure community was founded and Islam spread as a mercy to the worlds

puzzle.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ قَدْ جَآءَكُمُ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِٱلْحَقِّ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ فَـَٔامِنُوا۟ خَيْرًۭا لَّكُمْ ۚ وَإِن تَكْفُرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا
puzzle.verse: O mankind, the Messenger has come to you with the truth from your Lord, so believe; it is better for you. But if you disbelieve - then indeed, to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. And ever is Allāh Knowing and Wise. (4:170)
